name: Stoclet House
description: Stoclet House is a private mansion in Woluwe-Saint-Pierre, Brussels, designed by Vienna Secession architect Josef Hoffmann for banker Adolphe Stoclet and finished in 1911. Its crisp geometric blocks are clad in marble slabs, and inside are mosaic friezes by Gustav Klimt. It is still family-owned and closed to visitors, so most people admire it from the street.
